author: mishymishymishy33
body:
Anaheim- Kareem's for Mediterranean food

Tacos Los Gueros for tacos (cash only, better than Tacos los Cholos in my opinion)

Costa Mesa- Pupuseria San Sivar has excellent pupusas

Buena Park- Nancy's Pupuseria also has great pupusas and delicious empanadas

author: Wanderfuljen
body: Heck yes: Kareem’s Mediterranean in Anaheim! The best falafel.
